newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Unocal full year EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Unocal full year EPS cut.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Michael Young as cut his 1997 earnings per share forecast for Unocal Corp by $0.10 to $2.10 after the company reported adjusted earnings per share of $0.39 in the second quarter, below consensus forecasts of $0.45 per share.
Operating earnings at the company fell 30 percent, due to a 46 percent fall in oil and natural gas earnings as a result of lower prices.
Upstream earnings were $19 million below Young's forecast and exploration expenses of $60 million were double those of a year ago.
